title: System themes by default, with the live system accent
steps: With a profile that last used the built-in Light theme, launch Mail with -UseFakeData and open Settings > Appearance
In System Settings > Appearance, change the accent colour (try Yellow, then Purple) and look at the mail window
In Mail, pick the Light theme, quit and relaunch
Pick the Pine accent, then the System accent again
expected: The theme shows System Light (System Dark in dark mode) with the System accent. Unread dots, selection, links and buttons switch to the new accent without a relaunch; text on accent fills stays readable (dark text on Yellow). Light stays chosen after relaunch. With Pine, buttons and switches are pine; with System they follow the system accent again.
